subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing, and should that contract include Drive comment-thread replies?
rationale: The code shape is plugin-local and plausible, but adding a new operator config key and deciding whether comment-thread delivery is in scope are product/API decisions that source review cannot safely settle.

options.title: Accept Broad Feishu Pacing
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to cover chat message, media, streaming-card, and comment-thread burst paths with focused tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Message-API-Only Pacing
options.body: Narrow the docs and issue resolution to `im.message.create`/`im.message.reply` sends, leaving Drive comment pacing as a separate follow-up if maintainers want it.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Keep only the existing reactive retry/backoff behavior and leave the linked Feishu pacing issue open or close it as not planned.

recommendation.title: Accept Broad Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to cover chat message, media, streaming-card, and comment-thread burst paths with focused tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu/Lark behavior.
